decisions.reason: Close to the established offer and promoted on its own page, the sunk investment and public commitment make withdrawal unlikely.
Although distant from the core, the firm has already invested and publicly launched it, so escalation favors persistence while still carrying the highest drop risk.
A close-to-core product line with several models and a dedicated page signals strong, visible commitment and sunk costs, making dropping very unlikely.
